name: Konchu-Chan
source:
Have you ever wanted to date a cute insect girl?

Well, now you can!

Living in a future where bugs and humans have fused together, Miyazaki Kaito only wants one thing: to get a girlfriend!!

Will he be successful? There's only one way to find out! (By playing the game ;^O)

[From [url=https://palmistshouse.itch.io/konchu-chan]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你想和可爱的昆虫女孩约会吗？

好吧，现在你可以了！

生活在虫子与人类融合的未来，宫崎快斗只想一件事：找个女朋友！

他会成功吗？只有一种方法可以找出答案！（通过玩游戏；^O）

[来自[url=https://palmistshouse.itch.io/konchu-chan]itch.io[/url]]
